comments.author: Bryan1
comments.body: Price check on this? Looks amazing! Same dura as COG, 30 more sailors than COG, faster sail speed and row than COG, muchhhh better optional skill selection than COG (APN,PEA, Moored Mines, DHP). The onlyyy thing COG has 14 more armor. ANG with BPA or some 18/12 plates looks very comparable to COG. ANG looks better in melee as the extra sailor on this ship will win your inherited WMB vs all ship including COG. Only MLA can over take this ships WMB away the way the skill works. When COG is 30-40b, what would this be ranged at? I see a lot of WTBs in merch chat/ marketplace forum but no WTS. Seem like OGP knows the value and keeping as a rare drop as well.

comments.author: Ghoul
comments.body: Is there a way to know the minimum Durability of a ship? The point where it will no longer lose max dura.

comments.author: Wsp
comments.body: I believe it is 60% of the current max dura of the ship. Example the ship is 1000 dura so 600 dura is the least max dura it will have without going lower. Keep in mind this value will increase should you mod and grade for dura further.
